answer: Witnesses in many cities ping every newcomer and record its nadir latency to each city. Newcomers whose nadir pattern matches k-1 seated agents count as co-hosted with them. The k-th co-hosted agent is seated only after k ferrous chips each sign one copper voucher bound to its key, and every chip erases its own key after that single signature, so hardware is consumed rather than rented. An honest newcomer burns 1 chip, while an operator seating 100 agents on one host burns 5,050 chips, about $50,500 at $10 each.
